priorPublicContract.question: Switch to dynamic connectivity. Implement Python dynamic_connected(n, ops), returning booleans for ask operations. Operations are add(id,u,v), remove(id), and ask(u,v); queries see preceding operations. An id has at most one active edge, removals target active ids, and removed ids may be reused with different endpoints. Parallel edges and self-loops are valid. Both n and operation count are at most 200,000. Use a segment tree over time and rollback union-find. Supply executable snapshot and rollback code, explain activity boundaries and redundant unions, and derive time and storage bounds. Why can’t ordinary path compression remain with an unchanged union-only rollback log?

Now change ask to ('ask',u): return whether u’s current connected component is bipartite. Keep the same limits, edge lifetimes, parallel edges, and self-loops. Patch your executable code with rollback parity union-find. Your current `if a == b: return False` cannot simply discard every redundant edge. Explain why, and record enough state to undo contradictions and component merges exactly. Test a triangle that becomes bipartite after one edge is removed, and a self-loop in a separate component. What happens when two already non-bipartite components merge and that merge is rolled back? State invariants and updated time and storage bounds.

manualSourceReview.parity: For opposite-colored endpoints, the parity linking their roots is pu XOR pv XOR 1. XOR symmetry preserves this expression if roots are swapped for union by size.
manualSourceReview.contradictions: A same-root inconsistent edge logs and increments that root’s bad count. A consistent redundant edge does not change state. Component merges aggregate bad counts; asks inspect only their own root.
manualSourceReview.rollback: Reverse history restores old bad counts or detaches a merged root and restores the parent root’s old size and bad count. The detached root was a root before its merge, so resetting its parent to itself and parity to zero is valid; its size and bad count were retained.
manualSourceReview.lifetimes: An active edge lifetime covers [addition,removal), or ends at the operation count if not removed. Its disjoint segment-tree placement contributes it exactly once on each applicable ask leaf’s ancestor path. Reused IDs have separate lifetimes.
manualSourceReview.bounds: The visible implementation supports the stated O(N + T + (A log(T+1) + Q) log(N+1)) work under expected constant-time ID dictionary operations, and O(N + T + A log(T+1)) storage. Contradictions can generate O(A) live history entries; history is not limited to structural merges. These are source-level arguments, not measured maximum-size performance.
